title: The Great Commission
summary: Jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Matthew 28:16-20 and look for how this passage teaches: Jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them.

tell_it: After rising from the dead, Jesus sent His disciples to teach and baptize all nations. He promised His presence.
understand_it: Jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: The Great Commission reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Mission matters.
age_8_11_explanation: The Great Commission shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them.
teen_explanation: The Great Commission gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them.
God sends His people to share good news.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when mission is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did Jesus promise His disciples?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: I am with you always. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Matthew 28:20 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in The Great Commission?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Go Map
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from The Great Commission. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
